role: Defines vocabulary, preparation, scoring semantics, calibration, rules, and scoresheet fields.
examples: WCR sensory lexicon identifiers; current SCA standards; ISO 18794:2025 identifiers; WCC rules and official scoresheets
notes: Store governed identifiers, versions, and project decisions without reproducing protected content beyond permitted use.

role: Direct official judge, head-judge, panel, or production-cupping observation.
examples: Judge-level scores and descriptors; panel consensus; head-judge records; official structured sensory fields
notes: Highest-priority evidence. Consensus is derived with lineage and never overwrites judge observations. Model eligibility additionally requires affirmative model-research rights and all integrity gates.

role: Official organizer-published jury, lot, competition, or aggregate sensory evidence.
examples: Official auction-lot jury descriptions; official winning-lot descriptors; aggregate sensory profiles; competition feedback summaries
notes: Keep aggregated evidence distinct from P1. Model eligibility additionally requires affirmative model-research rights and all integrity gates.

role: Professional language declared by a competitor but not judge-confirmed.
examples: Brewers Cup presentation descriptors; declared WBC espresso notes; roast-plan target descriptors
notes: Auxiliary candidate-generation and terminology evidence only. Never relabel as judge-confirmed.

role: Roaster-submitted or commercial product language without official professional judge confirmation.
examples: Roaster tasting notes; commercial competition entry text; public winner marketing copy
notes: Auxiliary retrieval and terminology evidence only. Ordinary product pages do not establish preparation or judge provenance.

role: Consumer preference, ordinary review, machine-generated, synthetic, or project-authored evidence.
examples: Ordinary reviews; comments; liking surveys without professional judging; synthetic descriptors; LLM-generated notes
notes: May remain in separately governed historical or evaluation partitions but never enters the Round 3K professional corpus.
